entities.name: ADAPT (American Disabled for Attendant Programs Today)
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A grassroots disability rights organization in the United States known for direct action protests. Founded in 1983 by Wade Blank, ADAPT campaigned for accessible public transit and community-based attendant services.
